instruction: Using the opened Graphisoft/Archicad environment and the official Graphisoft/Archicad command-line or automation interfaces available in the environment, complete the model work from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and save the finished deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. The current model is a small two-level pair of mirrored residential units under a shared pitched roof.
